title: Tap graph node events from the blessed host executor
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore’s console needs live path lighting as a durable plan runs. They want the same short host wiring used for submit-once jobs — not a second hand-built executor — and still receive node start and end events for the active steps. Complements `fangore_host_kit_submit_once` and feeds console zoom stories such as `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`. He walks product steps (infer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^june-hf05-insp]
implementation: `mechaharness.host_kit.host_graph_executor` accepts `event_log=`. `tapping_event_log` / `TappingEventLog` forward emits to a host callback while preserving query. `CliInstrumentor` stamps then taps the blessed executor log so consoles see `core:graph_node_start` / `core:graph_node_end` on the same path as CLI infer (HF-05).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `tapped_node_lifecycle.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
